meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Create, edit, improve, or audit AgentSkills. Use when creating a new skill from scratch or when asked to improve, review, audit, tidy up, or clean up an existing skill or SKILL.md file. Also use when editing or restructuring a skill directory (moving files to references/ or scripts/, removing stale content, validating against the AgentSkills spec). Triggers on phrases like "create a skill", "author a skill", "tidy up a skill", "improve this skill", "review the skill", "clean up the skill", "audit the skill".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能按技能创建流程（理解需求、规划资源、初始化、编辑、打包等）生成或修改AgentSkills文件，并遵循渐进式披露原则节省上下文。
howto.when: 当你说“创建技能”、“改进这个技能”、“审计技能”等关键词，或要求创建、编辑、整理、审查技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个PDF编辑技能
say.note: Claude会引导你定义需求并初始化技能目录。

say.text: 改进这个前端构建技能
say.note: Claude会审查现有技能并建议优化。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can create or modify AgentSkills by following the skill creation process: understand requirements, plan resources, initialize, edit, package, etc., while adhering to progressive disclosure to conserve context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like 'create a skill', 'improve this skill', 'audit the skill', or ask to create, edit, tidy up, or review a skill.

say_en.text: Help me create a PDF editing skill.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through requirements and initialize the skill directory.
Claude will review the existing skill and suggest optimizations.
